verdict.rationale: The evidence pack documents pull-request code review, general branch handling, Gitea Actions CI, and user permissions/ACLs. None of it describes branch or tag protection rules that require approvals or passing status checks before merge. These are adjacent features, not the protection-rule capability itself, so the applicable axis has no supporting evidence.

support.subject: As a devops-lead, I can protect branches and tags with rules requiring reviews and passing checks before merge
